name: Courier Allocation
reads: Splits factory outbound batches across Ocean, Sea-Air, Rail & Truck based on DC stockout risk Connected CPG systems: Oracle OTM · SAP TM · NIC E-Way API.
does: Intercepts delayed ocean containers at transshipment hubs to upgrade only critical SKUs (Low-Latency Transactional State DB Multi-Modal Network Graph + Mathematical Optimization Solver (MILP / CP-SAT) Pareto Cost / Carbon / SLA Mode-Switch MILP).
returns: Balances freight rate, inventory carrying cost, ISO-14083 CO2e & customer MABD penalties Stages policy-checked action via Transportation Management System (TMS / MCP) / Supply Chain Execution Platform (MCP / API) Multi-Leg Booking Split (Ocean / Sea-Air / Rail / Road) & OMS Promise Update.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved Oracle OTM ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
